aliasNote: The source music registry key is `elevenlabs` with no alias. `el` is the existing local `open-sse/providers/registry/elevenlabs.js` alias for the same connection; no other provider uses it.

connectionModes.api_key: credentials.apiKey (trimmed) sent as `xi-api-key`; the existing local elevenlabs connection mode
connectionModes.access_token: source fallback: credentials.accessToken sent as `xi-api-key` only when no apiKey is present; no OAuth flow is added

endpoints.discovery: none: the source has no ElevenLabs music model discovery; listElevenLabsMusicModels() returns the pinned static list

request.wireBody: { model_id, music_length_ms (music_length_ms ?? duration*1000), force_instrumental (force_instrumental ?? instrumental), ...defined native fields }

response.shape: { object: 'music.generation', created, provider: 'elevenlabs', model, status: 'completed', data: [{ b64_json, format, mime_type, duration_seconds? }] }
response.resultContract: musicGenerationCore: { success, outcome, connectionId, accounting, response } | createErrorResult(...) + { outcome, connectionId, acceptedJob? }

publicHandlerIntegration.change: dispatch isElevenLabsMusicProvider(provider) to handleElevenLabsMusicGeneration({ model, body, credentials, signal }) before the MUSIC_ADAPTERS cookie lookup; reject requestId (synchronous, nothing to poll)
none beyond the existing acceptedJob branch: it already records recordAcceptedJobUsage and refuses fallback after an accepted job
